hero.label: About Us
hero.title: Steady guidance for complex decisions.
hero.subtitle: Founded on the principle that trust is the foundation of effective consulting, Acorn Benefits has served business owners, CFOs, and HR leaders with clarity, integrity, and unwavering advocacy.

story.heading: Our Story
story.p1: AcornBenefits was built by industry insiders, seasoned professionals who began their careers inside major employee benefit insurance carriers.  We understood how carriers price, underwrite and manage risk.  We use this knowledge to our client's advantage.
story.p2: We advise organizations on the strategy, structure,and ongoing management of their employee benefit plan.  Acorn works to maximize the value of the client's employee benefit plan while carefully managing the cost.
story.p3: Yes, we have saved our client's millions of dollars but cost reduction was not necessareily the mission, it is the outcome of smart strategy.  The people at Acorn Benefits see themselves as long term advisors to our client executive teams.

items.title: Integrity
items.desc: We provide transparent counsel, disclose all compensation, and place client interests above all else. No hidden agendas, no surprises.

items.title: Expertise
items.desc: Continuous learning keeps us ahead of regulatory changes, market trends, and emerging strategies. We bring deep knowledge to every engagement.

items.title: Partnership
items.desc: We measure success by your outcomes, not our commissions. Our relationships extend for years because we remain present when you need us.
